annotations.title: Bulk update listing prices or MOQ

description: Change the price or the minimum order quantity on up to 200 of your listings. Requires sign-in with seller access. price_set takes price_cents (integer cents). value_usd is an explicit dollar amount and is deprecated. The percent modes adjust the current price, and moq_set writes a minimum order quantity. Previous values are replaced. Sensitive: requires user approval each time.

mode.description: What to change and how: price_set writes an absolute unit price in cents via price_cents, price_percent_increase / price_percent_decrease adjust the current price by a percentage, moq_set writes a minimum order quantity.

price_cents.description: For price_set only. Absolute unit price in cents. 5000 means $50.00.

value.description: Percent (0-1000) for percent modes, or integer units (1-999999) for moq_set. Not accepted for price_set.

value_usd.description: Deprecated. For price_set only, an explicit price in US dollars. Prefer price_cents.
